description: This plot, titled “Massive Activation of baseline,” illustrates the maximum activation values across layers for four distinct components—“attn_output,” “attn_residual,” “ffn_output,” and “ffn_residual”—within a baseline model configuration. The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to 20, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5, representing the depth of the neural network. The y-axis, labeled “Max Activation Value,” ranges from 0 to 1600 on a linear scale, indicating the peak activation magnitude for each component at each layer. The “attn_output” is represented by a blue dashed line that rises sharply after layer 5, peaking near 1400 at layer 6 before dropping slightly. The “attn_residual” is shown as a green dotted line that remains near zero until layer 10, then rises to approximately 1000 at layer 20. The “ffn_output” is depicted as a red solid line that starts near zero, increases gradually until layer 10, then surges to around 1400 at layer 20. The “ffn_residual” is a red dashed line that remains near zero until layer 15, then increases to about 1000 at layer 20. The plot visually demonstrates the emergence of significant massive activations and attention sinks after the sixth layer, as indicated by the caption.
